language_boost.description: Optional language hint. Choose Automatic to let MiniMax detect the language, or pick a specific locale.

subtitle_enable.title: Subtitle Enable
subtitle_enable.description: Return MiniMax subtitle metadata with sentence timestamps (non-streaming only).

english_normalization.title: English Normalization
english_normalization.description: Improve number/date reading for English text (adds a small amount of latency).

fps.description: Frames per second of the video.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: Input audio to condition video generation. Supports flac, mp3, wav.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: Draft mode. Generates a lower-quality preview of the video.

image.title: Image
image.description: Input image to generate video from (image-to-video). Supports jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

no_op.title: No Op
no_op.description: Health check mode - returns status without inference.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds (1-20). Ignored when audio is provided.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the video. Ignored when an input image is provided.

last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image
last_frame_image.description: Reference image for the last frame of the video. Supports jpg, jpeg, png, webp.

prompt_upsampling.title: Prompt Upsampling
prompt_upsampling.description: Use prompt upsampling to enhance the prompt.
